title: Gameweek
description: Sent once when a gameweek session starts, in place of meta (#94). Every fixture plays on one clock, from t = 0. The session guarantees what the schema cannot: fixture ids are unique within a gameweek, and each fixture's speed and playback_delay_ms equal the gameweek's.

speed.description: Match seconds per real second, for every fixture.

playback_delay_ms.description: Real milliseconds the screens run behind the simulator.

fixtures.description: The three fixtures' MatchMeta, each with its fixture_id set. The JSON Schema requires fixture_id here; the generated pydantic and TypeScript types do not.
